Exact and reference solutions Analytic translation of a periodic sine is the standard. The problem merges different amplitudes and representations; the reference-library amplitude 0.25 is not the input for every execution example. Integrate continuous L2 error at additional Gauss points and compare final polynomials with the actual published DG at common points. Check weighted mass at every RK stage and quadratic energy at each completed step. A matrix exponential of the same FR operator separately measures RK3 time error and its timestep-halving response. Analytic referenceRelated-model reference Advection / sine translation u = 1 + 0.25 sin[2π(x−t)] Periodic unit interval; constant advection speed 1. Same periodic sine-transport model at speed one. The library amplitude is 0.25 versus 0.2 in the common fixed input; DG/CIP representations and output times also differ. Analytic referenceRelated-model reference WENO critical points: polynomial cell means and analytic periodic transport qbar_i=h^-1 integral_Ci q0(x-t)dx; q0=cos(2pi*x)+.1*sin(2pi*x)^3; local P=x+...+x^5, x²+x³+x⁴+x⁵, or x³+x⁴+x⁵. Local references integrate polynomials over five cells centered around x=0 and evaluate at h/2. Regular, first-critical and second-critical profiles use h=1/64…1/512. The actual periodic-transport reference is the Fourier-integrated cell mean of q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx) on[0,1], speed1,T1, checked independently by Gauss12 point-function quadrature. Local polynomials differ from the evolved profile; neither point samples nor another PDE calculation are substituted for cell means. An additional constant-speed periodic-transport reference.
